measurements.claim: over n <= 200 at the 109 working digits the budget formula asks for, the tribonacci Pisot ratio |lambda**n - round(lambda**n)| / |alpha|**n peaks at 1.999974821665813, so the bound of 2 is approached rather than comfortably respected
the tribonacci maximum over n <= 200 is attained at n = 192, so the worst case is one specific term of the scan and not a spread average
the tribonacci maximum sits 2.5178334186914952e-05 below the bound of 2, which is 1.3e-05 of the bound itself, so a tolerance written as 2 carries no margin in it

over n <= 200 at the 66 working digits the budget formula asks for, the plastic Pisot ratio |lambda**n - round(lambda**n)| / |alpha|**n peaks at 1.9999995588370636, so the bound of 2 is approached rather than comfortably respected
the plastic maximum over n <= 200 is attained at n = 183, so the worst case is one specific term of the scan and not a spread average
the plastic maximum sits 4.411629364042824e-07 below the bound of 2, which is 2.2e-07 of the bound itself, so a tolerance written as 2 carries no margin in it
the working precision a scan over n <= 200 needs for the plastic constant is 66 digits, from n_max * (log10(lambda) - log10(abs_alpha)) + 30
the modulus of the tribonacci conjugate pair equals sqrt(1/lambda) to within the working precision, so the two routes to it cannot disagree
the modulus of the plastic conjugate pair equals sqrt(1/lambda) to within the working precision, so the two routes to it cannot disagree
the bound of 2 is attained at none of the 9 ceilings probed, so it is a supremum of the ratio over n rather than a value the ratio takes
the measured maximum never falls as the ceiling rises, for either base, so the growth ladder climbs to a supremum instead of sawtoothing
the tribonacci argmax at n <= 200 is not the worst case at a higher ceiling: by n <= 3200 it has moved to n = 1881, so the pinned n is a property of the scanned window
the plastic argmax at n <= 200 has not moved off n = 183 at any of the 9 rungs up to n <= 3200, so for that base the pinned n is not an artefact of the window
at a ceiling of n <= 3200 the two bases peak at different n, so a shared argmax across the two of them would have been a coincidence of the window
raising the ceiling from n <= 200 to n <= 3200 shrinks the tribonacci deficit by a factor of 4933, which is what approaching a supremum looks like

for both bases the lowest working precision that respects the bound is lower on the residual route than on the power route, so the crossover is a property of the arithmetic rather than of the sequence and no single number for it belongs in a ledger

the set of working precisions that respect the bound is not a single interval, because the plastic residual route respects the bound at 39 while 40 digits break it, so a scan that treats the crossover as a threshold is wrong even where the threshold itself is right

the only working precision that respects the bound while a higher one breaks it is 39 on the plastic residual route, and every other probed precision on every route behaves as a threshold would predict

on both routes for both bases the highest working precision that still breaks the bound lies below the budget, so the budget is sufficient for the scan it sizes and the claim survives the route change

the digits of the maximum measured on a starved budget are not stable enough to pin as a ledger fact, because the working precision has to be right and not merely roughly right: on both routes the maximum moves by a large factor when three more digits are added, and the routes disagree with each other by many orders of magnitude on the same budget
whether the starved argmax moves when the budget moves is answered differently by the two routes, so the peak is a fingerprint of the rounding rather than a property of the sequence

the nearest integer to tribonacci lambda**n equals the integer trace of the roots for every n from 4 up and fails to at 2 of the 200 terms, so at those n the scan is not measuring the Pisot error at all

the nearest integer to plastic lambda**n equals the integer trace of the roots for every n from 10 up and fails to at 6 of the 200 terms, so at those n the scan is not measuring the Pisot error at all
the working precision a scan over n <= 200 needs for the tribonacci constant is 109 digits, from n_max * (log10(lambda) - log10(abs_alpha)) + 30
the worst of the two maxima sits within 1.3e-05 of the bound as a fraction, so the threshold verdict calls the bound tight for both bases
raising the ceiling from n <= 200 to n <= 3200 leaves the plastic deficit unchanged, so the plastic ladder never improves on its own n = 183 peak
